description: Create an i18n profile. Create a locale profile. `name` is the stable handle (e.g. `fr:prod`).

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `i18n_profiles_list` call. It proves you listed existing i18n profiles and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `i18n_profiles_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

name.description: Profile handle to create, e.g. `en:prod` or `fr:prod`. Lowercase alphanumeric start, then letters/digits/`_`/`:`/`.`/`-`; max 64 chars. The locale is encoded in the handle, so no separate locale fields are accepted.

name: i18n_profiles_create
